attributes.rule: A change from any other heading, except from [heading 8538](/headings/8538).

A change from [heading 8538](/headings/8538), whether or not there is also a change from any other heading, provided that the value of non-originating materials classified in [heading 8538](/headings/8538) does not exceed **50%** of the transaction value or ex-works price of the product.
